name: Cơm lam
summary: Rice cooked in a bamboo tube and eaten with sesame salt, out toward Langbiang or in Cu Lan village. Locals credit the sweetness to upstream water and the smell to young bamboo.
origin: Bamboo-tube rice on the Langbiang side of Da Lat and in Cu Lan village.
howToEat: Eat the tube with sesame salt, and with grilled forest meat, grilled chicken, and grilled eggs.
where: Toward Langbiang, or in Cu Lan village.
